_doc: Allowlist for tests/storage-locations.test.mjs. Every entry: where (file, repo-relative), key (storage key or SharedPreferences name), category (debug-flag | cache | device-specific | pending-migration | framework), reason (one line). User-visible settings must NOT be added here as permanent exceptions: they belong in settings.json (pending-migration entries are temporary and name the target store).

entries.reason: rootOptIn is a user choice -> settings.json.
Per-track lyric delay is song data -> library database.
Spectrogram window settings are user settings -> settings.json.
Legacy v1 key of the spectrogram settings, read once to carry values over -> settings.json.
A/B compare view preferences (mode, opacity, difference, wipe) are user settings -> settings.json.
Cover edit options are user settings -> settings.json.
Legacy key of the cover edit options (removed on load) -> settings.json.
Dragged artist column width is a user setting -> settings.json.
Last selected lyrics settings tab (key constant lives in floating-lyrics-settings.js) -> settings.json.
Original sample rate per Bluetooth device address; only meaningful on this phone.
Codec state per Bluetooth device address; only meaningful on this phone.
Reads the boolean `trace` debug flag of the floating lyrics file.
Legacy keys (locked, x_/y_<orientation>) read once, moved into settings.json through Rust and removed; only the `trace` debug flag and the `migrated` marker stay.
Copy of settings.json `language` so the first paint uses the right language (ADR 0019).
sessionStorage reload guard for language switching; not a setting.
Legacy key read once and removed to carry the old choice into settings.json (already stored there).
Prints startup timing marks to the console when set to 1.
Opt-in album reflow probe.
Opt-in cover swipe logging.
Opt-in ellipsis counters.
